sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Market leadership remains concentrated in four "all-green" sectors—led by Energy and Technology—while defensive and cyclical laggards fail to build meaningful momentum.

Four out of eleven sectors exhibit "all-green" status, indicating positive performance across all timeframes (weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD). Energy continues to dominate as the top momentum leader (0.92, rank 1), closely followed by Technology (0.83, rank 2). Healthcare (0.75, rank 5) shows exceptional structural consistency, marking it as the only sector sustained in the top 3 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. 

In contrast, rotational activity is highly restricted. Only Financials (+1 spot to rank 6) and Utilities (+1 spot to rank 9) managed to improve their rankings over the last five sessions. The remaining sectors are either stagnant or fading, with Consumer Cyclical anchored at the bottom of the momentum rankings (0.13, rank 11) and both Real Estate and Communication Services slipping in rank.

## Strength
* **Robust Breadth:** Four of eleven groups (Energy, Technology, Healthcare, and Financial) are "all-green," demonstrating positive performance across all measured horizons.
* **Energy and Tech Lead:** Energy remains the absolute momentum leader at 0.92 (rank 1), with Technology securely in second place at 0.83 (rank 2).
* **Sustained Healthcare Strength:** Healthcare (momentum 0.75) is the sole group to maintain a top-3 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month periods, confirming deep-seated defensive-growth demand.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Financials and Utilities Edge Up:** Financials (momentum 0.68, rank 6) and Utilities (momentum 0.28, rank 9) were the only sectors to improve their positions, each rising +1 spot over the last 5 sessions.
* **Communication and Real Estate Fade:** Communication Services (momentum 0.28, rank 10) and Real Estate (momentum 0.30, rank 7) are the week's top losers, both dropping -1 spot.
* **Severe Cyclical Lag:** Consumer Cyclical remains the weakest sector in the market with a momentum score of just 0.13, firmly rooted at rank 11.

## Divergences
* **No Fragile Leaders:** There are currently no fragile "all-green" sectors detected, indicating that the current leadership of Energy, Technology, Healthcare, and Financials rests on stable performance.
* **Basic Materials Neutrality:** Basic Materials holds a strong momentum score of 0.67 (rank 3) but shows zero rank improvement over the last 5 sessions, highlighting a pause in commodity-driven momentum.

rotation_phase.reasoning: Energy and Basic Materials are leading in momentum and YTD performance, which fits the Late Cycle profile of commodity-driven sector leadership.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** High-conviction leadership in energy, hardware, and shipping remains intact, but a powerful weekly rotation is lifting retail and regional banking while travel and commodity-linked groups face sharp pullbacks.

US equity market breadth remains highly concentrated, with only 22 of 144 industry groups maintaining "all-green" status across all time horizons. Absolute leadership is anchored by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.98) and Computer Hardware (momentum 0.96), which continue to hold the top two year-to-date ranks. This core strength is supported by sustained momentum in Marine Shipping (0.93) and Biotechnology (0.87).

Under the surface, a significant rotation is underway. Traditional retail and financial sectors are surging, highlighted by Department Stores jumping +30 spots and Regional Banks climbing +13 spots. Conversely, consumer travel and defensive groups are fading rapidly, with Insurance Brokers (-18 spots), Travel Services (-14 spots), and Lodging (-12 spots) leading the weekly declines.

## Strength
* **Concentrated Breadth:** Just 15% of the market (22 of 144 groups) is in an all-green posture, indicating highly selective leadership.
* **Top-Tier Momentum:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.98 momentum) and Computer Hardware (0.96 momentum) lead the market as the top two year-to-date industry groups.
* **Sustained Leaders:** Marine Shipping (0.93 momentum), Biotechnology (0.87 momentum), and Semiconductors (0.83 momentum) continue to show robust multi-month strength.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Retail and Utility Surge:** Department Stores (+30 spots to rank 77, momentum 0.73), Specialty Retail (+21 spots to rank 83), and Utilities - Renewable (+16 spots to rank 92) saw the largest weekly rank improvements.
* **Financial & Industrial Gains:** Regional Banks (+13 spots to rank 57) and Insurance - Life (+13 spots to rank 54) showed strong upward mobility alongside Textile Manufacturing (+17 spots to rank 31).
* **Sharp De-risking:** Insurance Brokers plummeted -18 spots to rank 108, while consumer-facing groups like Travel Services (-14 spots to rank 116) and Lodging (-12 spots to rank 73) suffered heavy damage.
* **Persistent Laggards:** Footwear & Accessories (0.038 momentum) and Advertising Agencies (0.120 momentum) remain anchored at the bottom of the year-to-date rankings.

## Divergences
* **Fading Leaders:** Copper (momentum 0.74, rank -7), REIT - Healthcare Facilities (momentum 0.66, rank -6), and Gold (momentum 0.73, rank -3) are slipping in rank despite carrying high momentum scores.
* **Emerging Turnarounds:** Specialty Retail (rank +21, momentum 0.47), Utilities - Renewable (rank +16, momentum 0.36), and Auto Parts (rank +10, momentum 0.43) are jumping in rank from low momentum baselines.
